subject.title: fix: resolve response prefix template variables in abort replies

question: Should this stale conflicting PR be rebased and broadened, or replaced by a new narrow fix on current main?
rationale: The remaining defects are concrete, but the branch predates large dispatch/routing changes and the desired repair crosses session model state plus routed delivery boundaries.
